puzzles.title: The last service
puzzles.subtitle: Briar House
puzzles.story: A dinner ended early. Five people were inside when the lights went out. Reconstruct the room, then name the killer.

puzzles.title: A quiet carriage
puzzles.subtitle: The northbound sleeper
puzzles.story: The night train never stopped. Someone in the first-class carriage knows why the conductor did.

puzzles.title: After the encore
puzzles.subtitle: Orpheum Theatre
puzzles.story: The audience has gone. Behind the curtain, five accounts of the final bow do not quite line up.

puzzles.title: The missing hour
puzzles.subtitle: Bell Street
puzzles.story: The clockmaker left one watch running. Place everyone in the workshop to reconstruct the last hour.

puzzles.title: Under glass
puzzles.subtitle: Winter garden
puzzles.story: Rain taps the glass roof. Nobody admits to entering the rare-plant collection that evening.

puzzles.title: The seventh painting
puzzles.subtitle: Gallery No. 7
puzzles.story: A private viewing. A switched label. One collector who never made it to the champagne reception.

puzzles.title: Low tide
puzzles.subtitle: Saltwater Point
puzzles.story: The ferry is cancelled and the island is cut off. The keeper was not alone in the lighthouse.

puzzles.title: A bitter blend
puzzles.subtitle: Paper Cup
puzzles.story: The cafe closed at six. The barista remembers every order, but not where everyone was standing.

puzzles.title: The final chapter
puzzles.subtitle: Wren Library
puzzles.story: An author invited four guests to hear the ending. Only four people left the reading.

puzzles.title: Static on the line
puzzles.subtitle: Station Nine
puzzles.story: The broadcast went silent. Work backwards through the studio to find who was beside the presenter.

puzzles.title: Snowbound
puzzles.subtitle: The Alpine Lodge
puzzles.story: The guests say they stayed in their rooms. The floor plan tells a rather different story.

puzzles.title: A perfect alibi
puzzles.subtitle: The observatory
puzzles.story: Every statement is true. That does not make everyone innocent. This time, use the relationships between clues.
